    ("T", "{I}R{n},{I}Z{n},",
     "{I}R{n},{I}Z{n},{I}S{n},IF(OR(" + DL + "),{I}AY{n},{I}R{n}),", 3),
    ("U", 'IF({I}B{n}="RB",{I}P{n},{I}BK{n})',
     'IF(OR({I}B{n}="RB",{I}B{n}="TE",{I}B{n}="OB-LB",{I}B{n}="CB",{I}B{n}="SAF"),{I}BL{n},{I}BK{n})', 3),
    ("R", "{I}AB{n},{I}W{n})",
     "{I}AB{n},{I}W{n},IF(OR(" + DL + "),{I}BD{n},{I}Y{n}),IF(OR(" + DL + "),{I}AZ{n},{I}Y{n}))", 3),
]

# CROSSWALK: (A position, C factor, F text in 026, F text in 027)
CW = "since 027"
CROSSWALK = [
    ("RB", "Quickness", "Get Off (DL, LB)", f"Get Off (DL, LB), CoD ({CW})"),
    ("WR / SLOT", "Quickness", "Get Off (DL, LB)", f"Get Off (DL, LB), CoD ({CW})"),
    ("TE", "Quickness", "Get Off (DL, LB)", f"Get Off (DL, LB), CoD ({CW})"),
    ("NT / DT", "Quickness", "Get Off (DL, LB)", f"Get Off (DL, LB), Disruption ({CW})"),
    ("END", "Quickness", "Get Off (DL, LB)", f"Get Off (DL, LB), CoD, Disruption ({CW})"),
    ("JACK", "Quickness", "Get Off (DL, LB)", f"Get Off (DL, LB), CoD, Disruption on EDGE rows ({CW})"),
    ("ILB (MLB / WLB)", "Quickness", "Get Off (DL, LB)", f"Get Off (DL, LB), CoD ({CW})"),
    ("CB", "Quickness", "Closing", f"Closing, CoD ({CW})"),
    ("SAF", "Quickness", "Get Off (DL, LB)", f"Get Off (DL, LB), CoD ({CW})"),
    ("STAR / NICKEL", "Quickness", "Get Off (DL, LB)", f"Get Off (DL, LB), CoD ({CW})"),
    ("RB", "Speed (Play-speed)", "Deep Speed, Top End Speed (mph)",
     f"Deep Speed, Power Speed ({CW}), Top End Speed (mph)"),
    *[(pos, "Speed (Play-speed)", "Deep Speed, Adjusted Speed, Top End Speed (mph)",
       f"Deep Speed, Power Speed (replaces Adjusted Speed {CW}), Top End Speed (mph)")
      for pos in ("TE", "ILB (MLB / WLB)", "CB", "SAF", "STAR / NICKEL")],
    ("JACK", "Speed (Play-speed)", "Deep Speed, Adjusted Speed, Top End Speed (mph)",
     f"Deep Speed, Adjusted Speed on EDGE rows, Power Speed on OB-LB rows ({CW}), Top End Speed (mph)"),
    *[(pos, "Toughness", "Yards After Contact, Tackles Avoided, Tackle Breaking, Push, Run Blocking, Run Defense",
       "Yards After Contact, Tackles Avoided, Tackle Breaking, Push, Run Blocking, Run Defense, "
       f"Double Team Rate, Run Stops Over Expected ({CW})")
      for pos in ("NT / DT", "END", "JACK")],
]

# METRIC GLOSSARY: (A metric, column, text in 026, text in 027)
GLOSSARY = [
    ("Get Off", "E", "Quickness (critical); Use of Hands / 1st step",
     "Quickness (critical); Use of Hands / 1st step. Telemetry: also reflects situational instinct, "
     "unlike Disruption"),
    ("Disruption", "D", "Backfield penetration on run plays while engaged.",
     "Backfield penetration on run plays while engaged. Telemetry: how quickly a player gets vertical."),
    ("Disruption", "E", "Knockback, Pad Level (position)",
     "Quickness (critical, IDL / EDGE, since 027); Knockback, Pad Level (position)"),
    ("Double Team Rate", "E", "Context for Pass Rush",
     "Toughness (critical, IDL / EDGE, since 027); context for Pass Rush"),
    ("Run Stops Over Expected", "E", "Knockback, Tackling (position)",
     "Toughness (critical, IDL / EDGE, since 027); Knockback, Tackling (position)"),
    ("Adjusted Speed", "E", "Speed (critical)",
     "Speed (critical) for WR, EDGE, QB. Replaced by Power Speed for TE, LB, S, CB (027): "
     "Telemetry says it reflects effort and motor more than athletic ability"),
    ("Power Speed", "E", "Size-Speed combo alert",
     "Speed (critical) for RB, TE, LB, S, CB since 027; Size-Speed combo alert"),
]
README_ADD = (" 027 (Telemetry suggestions, adopted by Mauro): CoD counts toward QUICK; Power Speed replaces "
              "Adjusted Speed in SPEED for TE, LB, CB, SAF and is added for RB; Disruption counts toward QUICK and "
              "Double Team Rate and Run Stops Over Expected toward TOUGH for IDL / EDGE. REVIEW unchanged.")


def patch_xml(src, out):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as zin:
        wb = zin.read("xl/workbook.xml").decode("utf8")
        rels = zin.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels").decode("utf8")
        rid = re.search(r'<sheet [^>]*name="REVIEW BOARD"[^>]*r:id="(rId\d+)"', wb).group(1)
        if f'Id="{rid}" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/worksheet" ' \
           'Target="worksheets/sheet9.xml"' not in rels and not re.search(
               rf'Id="{rid}"[^>]*Target="/?(xl/)?worksheets/sheet9.xml"', rels):
            raise SystemExit("REVIEW BOARD is not sheet9.xml")
        sheet = zin.read(SHEET).decode("utf8")
        hits = {c: 0 for c, *_ in PATCHES}

        def fix(m):
            letter, n, attrs, formula = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3), m.group(4)
            for c, old, new, times in PATCHES:
                if c != letter:
                    continue
                o, w = old.format(I=I, n=n), new.replace("{DL}", "").format(I=I, n=n)
                if formula.count(o) != times:
                    raise SystemExit(f"{letter}{n}: found {formula.count(o)} of {times} pieces")
                formula = formula.replace(o, w)
                hits[c] += 1
            attrs = attrs.replace(' t="str"', "")  # cached value dropped; Excel sets the type again
            return f'<c r="{letter}{n}"{attrs}><f>{formula}</f></c>'

        cell = re.compile(r'<c r="([RTU])(\d+)"([^>]*)><f>([^<]*)</f>(?:<v>[^<]*</v>)?</c>')
        sheet = cell.sub(lambda m: fix(m) if 5 <= int(m.group(2)) <= LAST_RB_ROW else m.group(0), sheet)
        want = LAST_RB_ROW - 4
        if any(v != want for v in hits.values()):
            raise SystemExit(f"patched rows {hits}, expected {want} each")
        wb = re.sub(r"<calcPr ", '<calcPr fullCalcOnLoad="1" ', wb, count=1)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(out, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
            for item in zin.infolist():
                data = (sheet.encode("utf8") if item.filename == SHEET
                        else wb.encode("utf8") if item.filename == "xl/workbook.xml"
                        else zin.read(item.filename))
                zout.writestr(item, data)
    print(f"patched {hits}", flush=True)


def set_text(sheet, key_col, rows, key, col, was, new, key2=None):
    for r in rows:
        if sheet.range(f"{key_col}{r}").value == key and (key2 is None or sheet.range(f"C{r}").value == key2):
            cur = sheet.range(f"{col}{r}").value
            if cur != was:
                raise SystemExit(f"{sheet.name} {col}{r} ({key}) is {cur!r}, expected {was!r}")
            sheet.range(f"{col}{r}").value = new
            if sheet.range(f"{col}{r}").value != new:
                raise SystemExit(f"{sheet.name} {col}{r} did not take the text")
            return
    raise SystemExit(f"{sheet.name}: no row for {key} {key2 or ''}")


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument("--src", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    out = Path(args.out).resolve()
    if out.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"Refusing to overwrite {out}")
    patch_xml(args.src, out)

    import xlwings as xw
    app = xw.App(visible=True, add_book=False)
    try:
        wb = app.books.open(str(out))
        print("opened", flush=True)
        cw = wb.sheets["CROSSWALK"]
        for pos, factor, was, new in CROSSWALK:
            set_text(cw, "A", range(5, 140), pos, "F", was, new, key2=factor)
        gl = wb.sheets["METRIC GLOSSARY"]
        for metric, col, was, new in GLOSSARY:
            set_text(gl, "A", range(1, 80), metric, col, was, new)
        readme = wb.sheets["README"]
        txt = readme.range("B11").value
        if not txt.startswith("PORTAL INPUT is filled by Power Query"):
            raise SystemExit(f"README B11 reads {txt[:60]!r}")
        if README_ADD.strip() not in txt:
            readme.range("B11").value = txt + README_ADD

        app.api.calculate_full() if hasattr(app.api, "calculate_full") else app.calculate()
        rb = wb.sheets["REVIEW BOARD"]
        for letter in "RTU":
            f = rb.range(f"{letter}5").formula
            if "BL5" not in f and "AY5" not in f and "BD5" not in f:
                raise SystemExit(f"REVIEW BOARD {letter}5 lost the patch: {f[:120]!r}")
        k = rb.range(f"K5:K{LAST_RB_ROW}").value
        print(f"REVIEW: {k.count('Y')}", flush=True)
        wb.save()
        wb.close()
    finally:
        app.quit()
    print(f"saved {out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# AGENTS.md

Project: PP_Recruiting (Baylor Football Player Personnel)

## What this is

A unified grading system for Baylor Football player personnel that couples
Telemetry (Teamworks) trait percentiles with the internal S.T.A.Q.S. grading
scale, so transfer-portal data gets filtered down to the players who deserve a
scout's time. The STAQS grade stays the grade of record. Telemetry data only
decides who gets reviewed. It never produces a competing grade.

## Two locations, know which is which

Workbooks, Word deliverables and the `Send/` folder live on Google Drive:

`G:\My Drive\00_Primary_Storage_Drive\02_SPORTS\Football\PP_Recruiting`

That folder holds the full project handoff in its own `AGENTS.md` and the
development history in `LOG.md`. Read both before doing work on the system
itself. They are the substantive spec. This repo is the version-controlled half:
documentation, decisions, and scripts.

An older copy of the project under `OneDrive - Baylor University` no longer
exists. Session logs and Codex rollouts that name that path are stale.

## Session routine

- Start: run `git pull`, then read `docs/STATUS.md` before doing anything else.
  Then read the Drive folder's `AGENTS.md` and `LOG.md`.
- End: update `docs/STATUS.md` (done, next, open questions), commit, and
  `git push`.
- Never leave uncommitted work at the end of a session.

## Conventions

- Durable notes and decisions go in `docs/`, committed. Not in chat.
- Workbooks, documents and data exports stay on Google Drive, not in this repo.
  Files over 95 MB never go in git.
- Telemetry and Teamworks are read-only. Navigate and read, never edit there.
- Writing: plain, direct, no em dashes. Documents use the Baylor design system.
- Deliverables on Drive are numbered in sequence. 013 is the latest, so the next
  one is 014. `docs/STATUS.md` holds the current number.
- The proposed Jev recruiting pilot is captured in
  `docs/2026-09-22-jev-recruiting-pilot.md`. It is a shadow-mode plan, not an
  approved workbook rule or a replacement for the weekly refresh.

## Standing rules carried over from the Drive handoff

- Threshold flags, never a weighted composite.
- Elite share, not raw elite count, because positions carry different trait
  counts (OL has 2, LB has 8).
- The data grades 4 of 5 critical factors, proxies Toughness, and never touches
  FBI, wiring, keep-ability, character, or medical.
- Do not retry reading Telemetry's auth token or importing its internal service
  classes. Both are blocked. Scrape the rendered table instead.

            seen.setdefault(c.column_letter, []).append((r, norm, v))

        mode, n = Counter(e[1] for e in entries).most_common(1)[0]

    rep.add("formulas", probs + drift, f"{len(base)} formula columns x {rows_checked} rows")
